correctness.rationale: Proposition 25 gives concentration in degree 3 and the identity value B_q for the specified categorical graph. In the augmented Lefschetz sum an invariant independent face with r vertex orbits contributes (-1)^(r+1); degree 3 makes its contribution to the homology trace (-1)^r. For s the orbit graph is K_q x K_q, whose independence complex is a wedge of (q-1)^2 circles; for st only the q diagonal orbits are admissible, and no two can coexist, so the trace is 1-q. I independently counted the t sum by partitioning selections according to the sheets containing an off-diagonal orbit. Every off-diagonal orbit in one sheet conflicts with every such orbit in the other (at least one of the two orders of the second pair has both coordinates different from a fixed ordering of the first). With no off-diagonal orbit the signed sum is q-1: the empty/on-one-sheet contribution is -1 and the q matching diagonal singleton pairs contribute +q. With off-diagonal orbits on just one sheet, zero or one opposite diagonal gives a factor (1-1) from the freely selectable same-sheet diagonals. Two opposite diagonals force the same-sheet diagonal set empty and permit just the one off-diagonal pair containing both, for contribution -1 per unordered pair. Three or more opposite diagonals permit no off-diagonal pair. The two sheets give q-1-2 binom(q,2)=-(q-1)^2, including q=2. Sign-character inner products give the multiplicities. Barycentric subdivision eliminates inversions; the quotient chain complex is the orbit coinvariant complex, and over Q exact averaging identifies its homology with invariants. Inspected the frozen checker and its stored output, which report finite corroboration, not an all-parameter certificate; no uploaded code was executed.
residual_risks: Only rational homology of the quotient is established; neither its integral homology nor an equivariant homotopy classification follows.

value.rationale: The two involutions are intrinsic symmetries of the equal-factor categorical product, not arbitrary tested permutations. The result determines all simultaneous eigenspaces at every size and the precise rational homology of the full natural four-element orbit space, which the nonequivariant sphere wedge and the single-sheet-flip trace do not determine. The uniform transpose calculation, rather than a known q=4 table entry or elementary character inversion, supplies the substantive increment.
residual_risks: Value is for this natural subgroup and these rational invariants, not a determination of all symmetries or the quotient homotopy type.
